the business model components of telemedicine services.
business models for telemedicine and the factors that influence their development and success.

telemedicine business models are still in the early stage of evolution and there is a need for further research in this area to develop a comprehensive framework for business model components for the telemedicine sector.

telemedicine business models should be designed to address the needs of all stakeholders and that they need to be flexible and adaptive to the changing environment.

business model components for successful telemedicine services are value creation and delivery through quality, efficiency and access, with a focus on patients, providers, vendors, insurers and government agencies as actors.

telemedicine is a promising service that can improve healthcare quality.
the business model of telemedicine should be aligned with the value it delivers to its stakeholders, which is a prerequisite for successful implementation.
